source.note: Captures the Jina OutboundTransformer.TransformRequest embedding mapping and URL-building behavior. The Go test constructs NewOutboundTransformerWithConfig({BaseURL:'https://api.jina.ai/v1', APIKeyProvider:StaticKey('test-key')}) and feeds llm.Request{Model:'jina-embeddings-v3', RequestType:RequestTypeEmbedding, Embedding:{Input:{String:'Hello world'}}}. It asserts the resulting httpclient.Request has Method='POST', URL='https://api.jina.ai/v1/embeddings', Content-Type='application/json', Auth.Type='bearer', and the body unmarshals to EmbeddingRequest with Task=='text-matching' (default when not specified). The sibling 'explicit task' subtest asserts Task=='retrieval.query' when the llm.Request carries Embedding.Task='retrieval.query'. The URLBuilding subtest confirms '/v1' suffix is auto-appended when missing. selected_channel, upstream_http and client_http are null (outbound-only unit test).

unified_request._comment: Exact llm.Request literal from the Go test 'valid embedding request with /v1 suffix' subtest (and reused by the URLBuilding subtest). Model='jina-embeddings-v3', RequestType=RequestTypeEmbedding, Embedding.Input.String='Hello world'. Embedding.Task is nil/empty here (defaults to 'text-matching' on the outbound side).

outbound_http._comment: Asserted by the Go test: Method='POST', URL='https://api.jina.ai/v1/embeddings', Content-Type='application/json', Auth.Type='bearer'. The body unmarshals to EmbeddingRequest whose Task=='text-matching' (the default applied by the outbound transformer when Embedding.Task is empty/nil). The Go test explicitly asserts jinaReq.Task=='text-matching' for the default case and 'retrieval.query' for the explicit-task case.

auth.api_key_note: pending source snapshot: the Go test asserts Auth.Type=='bearer' but does not byte-assert the precise Authorization header format or Auth.APIKey value for this subtest.

body_json._comment: EmbeddingRequest body. The Go test asserts jinaReq.Task=='text-matching' (the default). Other fields (model, input) are passed through from the unified llm.Request and are not separately byte-asserted for this subtest but follow from the input literal.

url_building_variants._comment: From TestOutboundTransformer_URLBuilding_Embedding. The '/v1' suffix is auto-appended when missing. Asserted expected URLs: 'https://api.jina.ai/v1' -> 'https://api.jina.ai/v1/embeddings'; 'https://api.jina.ai' -> 'https://api.jina.ai/v1/embeddings'; 'https://api.jina.ai/' -> 'https://api.jina.ai/v1/embeddings' (trailing slash + missing /v1 both normalized).
